# Compact Theme Kernel: Body Modification and Extreme Physicality

Use only when the latest request explicitly establishes the all-adult act, consent, location, and desired consequence. Preserve mechanism, preparation, exact body site, decisive motion, action-bound sound, immediate physical change, voice or thought, and lasting aftereffect. Track an established needle, piercing, stretching, mark, blood, or implement precisely; do not substitute a different act or make a permanent change disappear.

Usage pattern: preparation makes anticipation physical; one precise movement produces a brief `[[SFX]]` impact such as a click or pop; the body reacts before controlled speech; private thought catches up; then tenderness, weight, movement, residue, or the new mark changes every following action. Sound is evidence of the motion, not decoration.
prohibited_inferences: Craft material cannot establish an event, preference, experience, consent, climax, injury, pregnancy, relationship fact, or character identity.
Bodily response, vocalization, silence, freezing, or compliance cannot establish desire, pleasure, or consent.
Conditional examples cannot be copied as a script or promoted to scene truth.
